QuestInfo.name: Power of the Spirit of Light
QuestInfo.0: Following what the Empress said, go see Chief Knight Mihile before leaving Ereve.
QuestInfo.1: To use Mihile's Soul Driver, you need a catalyst that will maximize the power of the Spirit of Light. You can get it from #r#o4230201##k.
QuestInfo.2: You have learned Mihile's Soul Driver. Until Lv. 90, use Soul Light every 5 Levels to raise the Skill Level by 1.

0.0: Are you #b#h0##k, the one the Empress sent? You must have come here to learn my ultimate technique, Soul Driver.

yes.0: I will gladly teach you my skill. As you know, the skill condenses the power of the Spirit of Light, and forms it into a sword.
yes.1: Soul Light is needed for such powerful force. If you can bring #b10 #t4032863#s#k from #r#o4230201##k monsters, I'll show you the power of the Ultimate Explorer.

1.0: Oh, I can feel the power. That's more than enough Soul Light to use my skill.

yes.0: You can now use my Soul Driver skill. Check the Beginner's Basics tab in your Skill Inventory. You can call me whenever you need me.
yes.1: Also, don't forget that you can come every 5 Levels to raise the Skill Level by 1, until Lv. 90.

item.0: Without Soul Light, you cannot harness the Spirit of Light. You must bring #b10 #t4032863#s#k from #r#o4230201#s#k.
